_about: Owner's direction, Sept 21, 2026: make the learn-research-trade-fail-or-succeed loop as rapid as possible and use every input. Applied on top of the funded burst policy (whose record and spend caps are unchanged). Measured before: Luna sessions median 12 s, Sail pro_flex 241 s (p90 1,178 s); Sail was the underused budget. 20:26 UTC: all 16 research workers were busy with Sail sessions (multi-turn, replays inside), so 24. 22:10 UTC, owner adds $200 OpenAI and $100 Sail and asks for more gas: research every 5 min (winners every ~1.7), 32/8 workers, a newcomer every 2 min, population 64, Luna (median 12 s) back to three quarters. 23:55 UTC: rung-0 agents, which write all new code, averaged 8 research sessions in four hours on a $2 endowment and were displaced (median life 4.3 h); the endowment is 8.
